name: status-dashboard
title: Status Dashboard
description: A configurable Mac status dashboard for system, network, battery, and Codex usage.
author: zellux

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Open Status Dashboard
commands.subtitle: Mac and Codex status at a glance
commands.description: View the enabled system, network, battery, and Codex metrics.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Status Dashboard Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Compact status in the menu bar
commands.description: Show enabled metrics in a compact menu bar item.

preferences.name: showCpu
preferences.title: CPU
preferences.description: Include current CPU utilization in the dashboard and menu bar.
preferences.label: Show CPU usage

preferences.name: showMemory
preferences.title: Memory
preferences.description: Include current memory pressure and utilization.
preferences.label: Show memory usage

preferences.name: showDisk
preferences.title: Disk
preferences.description: Include usage for the macOS root disk.
preferences.label: Show disk usage

preferences.name: showNetwork
preferences.title: Network
preferences.description: Include live upload and download throughput for the default interface.
preferences.label: Show upload and download speed

preferences.name: showBattery
preferences.title: Battery
preferences.description: Include battery percentage, charging state, and estimated time remaining.
preferences.label: Show battery status

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.title: Codex / GPT
preferences.description: Include remaining Codex usage windows from the signed-in Codex CLI.
preferences.label: Show remaining Codex usage

preferences.name: dashboardRefreshSeconds
preferences.title: Dashboard Sampling
preferences.description: How often metrics are sampled. The dashboard redraws at most every 30 seconds to avoid flicker; manual refresh redraws immediately.

preferences.name: networkUnits
preferences.title: Network Units
preferences.description: Display network throughput as bytes or bits per second.

preferences.name: menuBarPrimary
preferences.title: Menu Bar Summary
preferences.description: Choose the primary value displayed beside the menu bar icon.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the Codex CLI executable.
